plans.idea: Keep the original's reading order but stretch it to the tall shape: logo crowns the top, a big bottle fills the upper half, then the headline, the CTA, and the legal and sticker at the foot, all centred on one axis.
Product-first story: the bottle takes the whole top half as a poster image, and the logo, headline and CTA form one tight message block in the lower half, so the brand sits right next to the message.
Headline-led: a small logo, then the headline set large in the top third, a much bigger bottle in the middle as the visual anchor, and the CTA under the product so the eye ends on the action.
